axis_reasons.hook: At 0.55 seconds the lid visibly separates and the teal flies rise; by 1.10 seconds the release is legible without captions. A coral fly waits beside them. This is an immediate action and useful visual contrast, although the first still image is a plain instructional arrangement.

The last gate answers the transport problem. Current sourcing is clear; the film avoids unsupported AI-only outcomes and does not use the excluded Zone 10 release.
axis_reasons.picture: All 20 directed intervals were inspected in exact-film before, middle and after frames. Pairing leads to closed eggs; the same landscape takes habitat, weather, outbreak markers, a target, trap and sterile fly release. Trailer motion leads to an inspection, phone and closed gate. Most meaning survives covering captions. A report sliding into place is less absorbing than the mechanism, and the closing gate intrudes on supporting text.
axis_reasons.place: Kerr County research and Kerrville are explicitly identified, and pale limestone-colored ground, low hills, scrub and ranch equipment are compatible with the setting. The landscape is deliberately schematic and the trees are generic blobs, so a local viewer receives limited place recognition beyond the attribution. No incompatible biome or wardrobe was observed.
axis_reasons.craft: The recurring teal fly, coral fly, ochre landscape and teal target preserve continuity across cuts. Captions stay legible at 360 pixels. The film has generous negative space and some long flat intervals while evidence is read. At the end, the gate overlaps a supporting label; the diagonal-road trailer also appears slightly detached from the road surface. These weaken finish without obscuring the action.
axis_reasons.voice: The exact mix has an external audio-capable model assessment accepting clarity and balance while describing a formal performance and minor artifacts. Silence-anchored caption boundaries and exact acoustic reconciliation support timing; these are not my own listening. That limited basis supports a cautious passing score rather than an independently heard performance verdict.
